speaker: Serra
text: I'm not going to pretend to you. On the road you were reckless, and it worked, and reckless-that-works is the most dangerous habit a person can have. It runs out. It always runs out.

speaker: Kai
text: So the pitch is 'you'll get yourself killed.' Bold.

speaker: Serra
text: The pitch is that you woke a power no one at this school understands, including you, and untaught power doesn't protect the people you keep throwing yourself in front of. It buries them next to you.

speaker: Serra
text: Tidemark holds the line. We can teach you to hold yours — to aim what you did on that road instead of just surviving it. Discipline isn't a cage, Kai. It's the difference between a fire and a hearth.

speaker: Kai
text: ...you're the first person here who didn't look at the mark first.

speaker: Serra
text: I looked at what you did with your hands. The mark is a question for later. Come to Tidemark, and I'll make sure you live long enough to answer it.
